trace.coalescing: none; exactly one event per 100 ms trace slot

lifecycle.catchUp: prohibited; fail immediately when the next slot is already more than 20 ms late
lifecycle.completion: after the final event paint acknowledgment and model finish

trace.sort: stable score then stable row ID tie break
trace.edit: replace one signed score by row ID
trace.scroll: integer CSS pixel offset clamped to filtered extent

output.hostRule: The host executes typed commands only; it does not reduce model state or rebuild expected DOM.

allocationPolicy: allocations counts dynamic application-owned allocations inside the 300-event trace; fixed setup buffers and post-trace result materialization are outside the trace and excluded
boundaryPolicy: Count every operative exported Wasm function call: input_ptr, prepare, result_ptr, 300 run_event calls, and finish (304 crossings). Memory reads and writes through the exported Memory object are counted as bytes, not function crossings.

phases.exclusivity: Load, transfer, instantiate, compute, and render retain individually labelled non-overlapping spans. End-to-end is the containing envelope; the residual outside exclusive spans is retained as unattributed duration.
phases.load: resource fetch through response validation, JSON.parse, and SHA-256 hashing; excludes response body arrayBuffer, Uint8Array construction, and TextDecoder construction/decode
phases.transfer: response body arrayBuffer, Uint8Array construction, and build-manifest TextDecoder construction/decode
phases.instantiate: WebAssembly.instantiate only; zero for the JavaScript target
phases.compute: controlled model prepare, 300 event steps, and finish
phases.render: host command application through two animation frames for each event
phases.endToEnd: Start activation through receipt of completion after final paint acknowledgment
phases.reconciliation: exclusive phase sum plus unattributed duration equals end-to-end duration
